_comment: Film 28 Mirelo SFX 2.0 (mirelo-ai/sfx2.0/text-to-audio, 0.01 USD/s, 1 sample each, mp3). Files in <scratch>/sfx, not in the repo. Library (sfx-bibliothek/akzent+atmo): stone_click (countdown station), wings, foghorn, rain.

room_tone.prompt: Very quiet room tone of a small studio at night, faint electrical hum, soft air, almost silent, loopable, no music, no voices.

desert_wind.prompt: Soft dry desert wind over sand at dawn, gentle steady breeze, faint distant gusts, no music, no voices, loopable.

ocean.prompt: Deep open ocean at night, low swell, water slowly moving, distant soft waves, no music, no voices, loopable.

train_brake.prompt: A freight train brakes with a long metal squeal and steel wheels slowing to a stop on a track at night in a quiet forest, crickets, no music, no voices.

sky_sweep.prompt: A soft low rumble and a rising airy sweep, like a large wave of air travelling up into the sky and fading, cinematic, no music, no voices.
